verdict.rationale: Rollbar documents a RESTful public API at docs.rollbar.com/reference covering items, occurrences, metrics and deploys, with concrete endpoint examples such as listing and paginating items. It publishes a downloadable OpenAPI 3.1 spec and uses scoped access tokens for programmatic auth. The probe's 404s on standard OpenAPI paths do not contradict this, because the spec is linked from the docs' OpenAPI page. Missing for 10: the docs say the API covers only 'much of' the system rather than all of it, and there is no independent or hands-on confirmation of driving the product end-to-end through the API.
